_help: "players": "all" gives every Husker on the NFL Tier 1, MLB and NBA lists a page. Add "overrides": {"Player Name": "Exact Wikipedia Article Title"} when the automatic lookup picks the wrong article or misses one. For a baseball or basketball player, write the key as "baseball:Player Name" or "basketball:Player Name". An override is trusted even if the article does not mention Nebraska, so check it is the right person.
